correctness.rationale: For all integers g>=13 with 3 not dividing g and h>=1, the gaps of <6,9,g,g+3> partition as {3}, A in residue g mod 3 from its least positive representative to g-3, and B in residue 2g mod 3 to 2g-3. The proof of the h=2 base establishes uninterrupted step-3 intervals in each residue; induction using G containing {1,2,3} propagates contiguous pieces with initial terms h,h+1,h+2. The maximal sums, by minimal losses from h(2g-3), are hF, hF-g, hF-(2g-6); hence the two disjoint omitted arithmetic progressions have g-3 entries and |hG|=(2h-1)g-4h+4. The Buchweitz deficit is 2h-3>0 for all h>=2. Independently computed complete semigroup memberships and sets for 13 admissible genera and six orders (78 pairs) exactly matching both progression holes and cardinalities. This finite check corroborates, not proves, the universal identity. Non-Weierstrass status itself is imported from Eisenbud-Schreyer rather than proved here.

This is an infinite-parameter structural classification, not merely recomputation of the known non-Weierstrass status or an arbitrary small genus.
